items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: there was a newcomer, Jimmy Smith, he's the one that danced on the vibraphone.

ctx.x: Because I know there are tap dancers that do that.

Yes, there was one -- well, there was originally two. I mean, the vibraphone. Will Mahoney danced on the xylophone or the marimba, and then there was a newcomer, Jimmy Smith, he's the one that danced on the vibraphone. But he made this, you know, by hand. He made the instrument himself.
So tell me some of the -- can you tell me some of the routines that you used to do, some of the joking you used to do, and maybe even some of the dancing at this point?
